In 2000, psychologists at Cornell had students put on a t-shirt with a giant face of a singer most of them found deeply embarrassing.
Then they walked into a room full of people.
Everyone is staring at my shirt...
Afterward, the students guessed how many people noticed the shirt.
They believed twice as many people noticed...
You're the center of your own world...
so you assume you're the center of everyone else's too.
